acceptance.canonicalization_algorithm: JCS_LIKE_V1: recursively normalize JSON object keys and string values to Unicode NFC; reject normalized-key collisions before serialization; UTF-8; objects sorted lexicographically by normalized key; arrays preserve order; version fields require JSON integer type exactly; separators comma/colon; no insignificant whitespace; LF only
acceptance.duplicate_gate: Derive the domain-tagged canonical-JSON semantic-core idempotency key before any write. A candidate with an already-observed identical key is classified DUPLICATE and produces no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack post. Best-effort repository search must show no existing proposed key before the first write.
acceptance.idempotency_formula: sha256(canonical_json_utf8({domain:'hfo.gen133.x12.idempotency.semantic-core.v3',semantic_core:{campaign_id,controlled_probe_name,current_blob,expected_version,next_version,object_id,prior_digest_sha256,task_id,transition_kind,wake_ordinal}})); nonce, valid_time, transaction_time, verifier runtime metadata, and Slack metadata are excluded
acceptance.next_wake_requirement: If accepted, run X12_IDEMPOTENCY_STRATEGY_C9 wake 4/4 from CURRENT v35. Vary only the idempotency strategy probe, reject duplicate idempotency keys and stale expected versions, return KEEP | REVISE | RESEAT_VARIABLE | HOLD, select the next factor, and do not claim database or cross-system transaction guarantees.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Event-first. After immutable event commit and exact readback, fetch CURRENT a second time and require exact version 34, projection digest c2038ae1b523175276accf9532e0f683c9e43a51ff98e86ab8081b6d9e6c016f, and blob f984a45b35244be37951c930a094aa50ac12a446. Replace CURRENT only using that exact blob SHA. Then read back CURRENT, the v35 event, and the v34 predecessor event and require exact latest-event, predecessor-event, prior-digest, prior-CURRENT, campaign-progress, and idempotency-measurement bindings.
acceptance.slack_post_rule: Post one sanitized pointer only after CURRENT advances to v35. A duplicate or unchanged transition produces no Slack post.
acceptance.stale_version_gate: Any expected-version or prior-blob mismatch must fail the single-file CURRENT replacement and must not be retried as an unconditional overwrite.

experiment.baseline: CURRENT v34 at blob f984a45b35244be37951c930a094aa50ac12a446; C9 idempotency_strategy 2/4; prior event digest 4a67df2d042eaf0b4f7f8ef5be41aa63eb26356556abdc5c0fda7b8f23a08334. Wake 2 replaced pipe-joined semantic fields with a canonical JSON semantic-core object but did not bind a protocol/domain identifier into the key preimage.
experiment.controlled_factor: Idempotency-key preimage envelope only. Wrap the unchanged canonical JSON semantic core in a named domain field before hashing. Retain event-first ordering, exact second CURRENT read, compact dual anchors, exact prior blob-SHA replacement, and sequential post-update triangulation.
experiment.exact_probe: Construct one canonical semantic-core object and treat it as reused by two protocol contexts. Verify the untagged canonical semantic-core bytes and digest are necessarily identical in both contexts. Wrap the same object once with the X12 domain and once with an X14 comparison domain, verify wrapper bytes and digests differ, derive the accepted v34-to-v35 key from the X12 wrapper, require zero repository matches for that key, and advance at most one transition.
experiment.honest_flaw: This is a bounded synthetic cross-context specimen using two literal domain strings and one Python JCS-like implementation. It does not prove that all producers choose stable globally unique domains, that consumers reject unknown domains, or that other languages reproduce the bytes. GitHub code search is best-effort, non-atomic, and can lag. The immutable event and CURRENT are separate commits and Slack follows both, so a crash can leave an orphan event or missing Slack pointer. GitHub's per-file blob-SHA guard does not provide cross-file atomicity, locks, linearizability, serializable isolation, database durability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side uniqueness, or automatic repair.
experiment.hypothesis: Binding a stable protocol/domain identifier inside the canonical JSON idempotency preimage prevents the same semantic-core bytes from producing one reusable key across distinct workflow contexts.
experiment.rollback: Never delete the immutable event or Slack message. If domain-tagged canonical-JSON keying is later rejected, append a compensating event from the then-current version and replace CURRENT only using that pointer file's exact then-current blob SHA; preserve this specimen and reconstruct history from immutable events and referenced prior CURRENT blobs.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: The two wrappers produce identical bytes or digests despite different domains; the X12 accepted wrapper fails recomputation; the proposed key already existed but the search missed it; the same key advances state twice; an expected-version or prior-blob mismatch still advances CURRENT; event bytes fail digest recomputation; or final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree.
